Feature.risk_justification: Unchanged from discovery - three modules (model-run.sh, model-stats.py tests, model-registry.json), one new machine-local directory, additive journal keys; no public API break, no auth surface.
Feature.evidence_justification: Every design choice cites file:line of the current code or a local command run on 2026-09-24 (GNU grep 3.11, GNU findutils 4.9.0, GNU coreutils 9.4 mktemp, jq 1.7).

technology_stack.Item: jq 1.7 (journal line, registry reads - already used)
GNU coreutils (mktemp --suffix, wc, date, timeout - already used except --suffix)
GNU grep (already used by classify; now also for --expect)
GNU findutils find (new for the runner - retention)

Item.D-1__FR-1_: exit-code gate - text patterns are consulted only when exit is non-zero; exit 0 goes to the answer checks.

Item.D-2__FR-3_FR-4_NFR-6_: kept outputs in $(dirname JOURNAL)/model-outputs, override MODEL_OUTPUTS; files created there by mktemp from the start; retention by find inside model-run.sh on every real run, days from registry policy.output_retention_days (14).

Item.D-3__FR-5_FR-6_: flag --expect REGEX (grep -E, case-sensitive, validated at startup, rejected if it matches the task file); one new outcome check_failed for both empty output and regex miss; never penalised.

Item.D-4__FR-7_: model-stats.py code unchanged; new tests pin rendering of check_failed and tolerance of new keys.

Item.D-5__FR-8_: models.<name>.capabilities = {web_search - bool} on all ten models, provenance in top-level capabilities_source; latency explained in one _comment line, no new number.

Item.D-6__FR-9_: task-57 re-run through the phase-2 runner with an anchored --expect; acceptance verified by the main session with curl; journal lines recorded in a bd comment with out_path reduced to its file name.
